target: For every complex PSD Toeplitz matrix T of size n+1, construct HasAtomicRepresentation T T.rank: exactly rank(T) distinct unit-circle nodes with strictly positive real weights reproducing every entry. First prove arbitrary singular rank <=n by induction/PSD extension uniqueness; attempt the full-rank case by a positive rank-one Toeplitz downdate. Claim only completed cases.
conventions: Original simultaneous shift invariance, full Hermitian two-sided matrix; entries sum w(z)*conj(z^i)*z^j; finite support implies distinct nodes; zero-rank support is empty. Ordinary ascending polynomial coefficients in kernel arguments.
DH_analogue: The identical finite linear-algebra theorem for any DH-derived matrix satisfying the same PSD and Toeplitz assumptions. No arithmetic PSD estimate or new separator.
